{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Longbow''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of four [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] that were attempting to box in and destroy the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Chie (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Chie'']]. They had [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] in [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] as their starfighter superiority against [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue squadron]] in [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]].
